department: Neuroscience PhD Program (Helen Wills Neuroscience Institute)

deadline.value: Apply by Thursday, November 19, 2026, 8:59 pm Pacific; late applications are not reviewed.
deadline.quote: The application for Fall 2027 admissions will open on September 24, 2026 and is due Thurs. November 19, 2026 at 8:59pm Pacific Time (11:59pm Eastern Time).

gre_subject.value: The program says nothing about the Psychology Subject GRE.

english_waiver.value: The program states that applicants from Indian institutions must submit TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: This requirement applies to institutions from Bangladesh, Nepal, India, Pakistan

supervisor.value: Most students enter the general program with three first-year rotations; a direct-admit route exists only for applicants invited by a faculty member.
supervisor.quote: In this program, entering students perform 3 research rotations in different labs in Year 1, use these research experiences to select a thesis lab in late Spring of Year 1

funding.value: Funding terms are not stated on the program's admissions pages checked.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's (GPA 3.0+) is enough, but the program requires at least two years of laboratory research experience.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale is required for admission. | In addition, the Neuroscience PhD Program requires applicants to have at least two years of laboratory research experience.

notes: Higher speaking minimums than the Graduate Division: TOEFL Speaking 26 (tests before Jan 21, 2026) or 6 (new scale), IELTS Speaking 8. Select 6-8 faculty on the application.
